Loaded: the two design-basis projects of Table 2.1 (30,000 bbl/d SAGD; 100,000 bbl/d stand-alone mining and extraction): capacity, life, initial capital total and per bbl/d, non-energy operating cost, natural gas and electricity per bbl (derived from GJ/d and MWh/d, formulas in file), and the thermal and hydrogen energy intensity factors by project type from Figures 3.6 and 3.7 (median and latest empirical value as separate processes; only numbers printed as labels). Supply-cost components (Table 2.4), sustaining capital and price/rate assumptions went to other-values. Not loaded: upgrader capex/opex (Study 163 evaluates only SAGD and mining supply costs; upgrader cost detail is in Study 164, ceri_2017_002), CSS/cogeneration/integrated cost data (not given), production forecasts, royalties, diluent and transport chapters, emissions (Fig. 3.15 is aggregate Mt only; no per-bbl emissions printed). Locator convention: printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 20). PRICE YEAR: all costs are real 2015 Canadian dollars (stated in the study). Traps: (1) the supply cost is an NPV-zero price including royalties, taxes and 10% real return, not a production cost; (2) Fig. 3.6/3.7 median and latest empirical values differ strongly (SAGD 1.18 vs 0.97 GJ/bbl; mining median 0.33 vs design-basis 0.54 GJ/bbl); the factor is natural-gas-equivalent GJ per bbl of output (bitumen for extraction, SCO for upgrading and integrated); (3) design SAGD gas use 1.197 GJ/bbl corresponds to SOR about 2.8 (Study 164 uses SOR 3.0 for the same plant and capex); (4) unit bbl kept as printed (1 bbl = 0.158987 m3); (5) Table 2.1 prints electricity 300 MWh/d for SAGD (Study 164 Table 2.6 prints 300 kWh/day, almost certainly a typo).
